notes: Drops .inOrder() from a Google Truth containsExactly(period0, period1) on the DRM keys loaded events, because a pre fetched key load for the second period can finish before the blocking one for the first (commit title "Fix flaky DRM assertion in AnalyticsCollectorTest"). The values are still checked, only their order is not. ADR 0007 Decision 5 lists Google Truth containsExactly(...).inOrder() to the same containsExactly(...) without inOrder() as an allowlisted order only relaxation (kind 2), since Truth counts duplicates and inOrder() adds only the order check, so the patch is accepted. The new comment lines are removed by the lexer before any rule runs. Verbatim: the whole single file diff of the commit.
